purpose: Distinguish α_c position uncertainty from Δα transition width

statistic_1_delta_alpha.interpretation: Entire CI below α_c CI width (0.133), confirming transition is sharper than estimation uncertainty

statistic_2_delta_p.interpretation: Always positive (100%), but CI wide because α_c uncertainty spans this interval

statistic_3_fisher.description: Fisher exact test: α≤0.45 (0/64) vs α≥0.50 (18/32) [D148-corrected: α=0.60 PermG=0/8]
statistic_3_fisher.interpretation: Model-free evidence that detection rate jumps between α≤0.45 and α≥0.50. D148-corrected (old: 21/32 p=1.65e-13; new: 18/32 p=3.45e-11, qualitatively unchanged).

key_distinction.conclusion: α_c CI width (0.133) measures WHERE uncertainty; Δα (0.008-0.060) measures HOW SHARP. They are independent. The transition is genuinely steep even accounting for all parameter uncertainty.

framing_recommendation: C1 steep onset claim SUPPORTED. Present Fisher as model-free jump evidence, Δα as parametric sharpness, α_c CI as honest location uncertainty. Explicitly distinguish the two quantities in Methods or Results.
